About the Platform

Built for aspiring
Chartered Surveyors

Get Chartered AI is a structured APC preparation platform built by Chartered Surveyors who have been through the process themselves. Twelve modules covering every mandatory competency. Sprint-specific coaching for candidates preparing under pressure. Six specialist modules for referred candidates. All 22 RICS pathways supported from day one.

The platform doesn't just give you content to read. It builds the way you think, speak and evidence your experience — because that's what the APC actually tests. Most candidates who are referred know their subject. What separates those who pass is the ability to demonstrate it clearly, under pressure, in the format assessors score.

Meet Michael — your AI Tutor

Michael is not a chatbox. He is a coaching presence built into every competency module. In Tutor Mode he meets you where you are — helping you shape real experience into competency evidence and naming the level of every answer. In Assessor Mode he challenges you exactly as the panel will — directly, without softening, with the follow-up questions you were not expecting.See Michael in action →

Meet Michael

Your AI Tutor. Available every time you need him.

Most APC candidates revise content but never practise performing under pressure. Michael closes that gap — available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, in two distinct modes.

Tutor Mode
For learning and understanding

Ask questions, explore competencies, get explanations. Michael meets you where you are — patient, thorough, never rushed. Use him alongside every module throughout your preparation.

Assessor Mode
For pressure testing

Michael switches. He asks the questions assessors ask. He follows up. He probes. He will not let a vague answer pass. Use him when you think you are ready — and find out if you really are.

Why Get Chartered AI

What changes when you prepare properly.

Every element of this platform is built around one question: what does a candidate need to walk in confident and come out chartered.

🎯

Stop preparing in the dark

Every module is built around how assessors actually score. You learn what they're looking for, not just what the competency says.

⏱

Michael challenges you like a real assessor

Ask Michael to explain a concept, challenge your answer or work through a scenario with you. Available inside every module, every competency, any time.

📅

Walk in knowing what's changed

The Industry Briefing is updated every assessment window by Chartered Surveyors. The topics most likely to come up in your window. Always current.

🎓

50 Questions Every APC Candidate Should Be Able To Answer

Your pathway-specific question bank. 50 assessor-led technical questions built around how your pathway is actually tested. On top of 1,000+ questions across the mandatory competencies. Know the questions. Know the answers. Walk in ready.

📝

A 60-minute mock interview that doesn't let you off

Timed, AI-scored, assessor-led. The closest thing to the real panel without the consequences.

📋

Build your evidence as you go

The PREP Builder helps you structure and refine your competency examples using the same framework assessors use. Michael reviews each entry and tells you exactly what to strengthen.

🗺️

Track your CPD and submission readiness

Built-in CPD log, competency evidence bank and submission checklist — the tools your counsellor wishes you had from day one.

🏆

Built by Chartered Surveyors who passed

Every module, every question, every coaching prompt written by practitioners who sat in front of a panel and know exactly what it takes.

Submission Checklist

This checklist is a preparation guide only. Always verify your submission requirements and deadlines directly with RICS. Get Chartered AI is not responsible for submission compliance or deadline management.

📝 Case Study Review — Michael's Coaching

Paste your case study draft below. Michael will review it and give you specific coaching feedback.

RICS Case Study Requirements

Your case study is strictly limited to 3,000 words maximum. This includes headings and subheadings but excludes the cover page, contents page and appendices.

The recommended structure is:

  • Introduction — approximately 400 words
  • Approach — approximately 1,000 words
  • Achievements — approximately 1,200 words
  • Conclusion — approximately 400 words

Source: RICS APC submissions and assessment guidance

This is AI-generated coaching feedback to help you develop your case study. It is not an official RICS assessment and does not predict your outcome. Always review feedback with your counsellor before submission. Get Chartered AI accepts no responsibility for APC submission outcomes.

Case Study Review

AI Coaching on your Case Study Draft

Paste your case study draft and Michael will give you structured coaching feedback — not a mark, not a score, but specific guidance on what is working, what to strengthen and the questions your assessor is likely to ask.

RICS Case Study Requirements

Your case study is strictly limited to 3,000 words maximum. This includes headings and subheadings but excludes the cover page, contents page and appendices.

The recommended structure is:

  • Introduction — approximately 400 words
  • Approach — approximately 1,000 words
  • Achievements — approximately 1,200 words
  • Conclusion — approximately 400 words

What Michael reviews

  • What is working well in your draft
  • What to strengthen before submission
  • Questions your assessor is likely to ask based on what you have written
  • One thing to discuss with your counsellor
Important: This is AI-generated coaching feedback to help you develop your case study. It is not an official RICS assessment and does not predict your outcome. Always review feedback with your counsellor before making final changes. Get Chartered AI accepts no responsibility for APC submission outcomes.
